subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting anticlockwise around a circular table in the same sequence at equal distances between them. All are facing the centre of the table. S is facing the south. Then V and Q interchange their positions. In which direction is Q sitting now?
solution:
The sequence followed here is :-

1) S is facing the south.
